summary: The rectangle inclusion proves the pointwise product-depth bound for every product normal, including zero components and boundary atoms. Cubing and averaging uses exactly the original atom probabilities. The scalar quantile coupling proves the bound for arbitrary unequal atoms, and the explicit equal-mass sequence establishes the stated infimum and product sharpness. Singleton and lower-dimensional supports, points outside the supports, and the stated zero-dimensional depth-one convention are all covered.
